cosine-primitive.title: Cosine primitive
cosine-primitive.contract: For rational 0 ≤ t ≤ 1/2, the fixed cosine-sum program is equivalent to the separately computed S(t)/pi.
cosine-primitive.obligation: Endpoint identity; integral validity is measured separately.

cosine-validity.title: Cosine integral validity
cosine-validity.contract: The SAME integral program has ordered nested rational output boxes with widths tending to zero, for all rational t in the same chart.
cosine-validity.obligation: Construction correctness. This is a second obligation of the cosine example, not a second independent integration example.

sine-zero.title: Sine at zero (calibration)
sine-zero.contract: The closed native sine program at zero is equivalent to the constant-zero interval program.
sine-zero.obligation: A two-route calibration of reusable value bridges; excluded from the default calculus portfolio.

roadmap.title: Polynomial FTC, uniformly in degree
roadmap.contract: Choose one coefficient-list polynomial evaluator and one fixed quadrature; compare direct finite sums, native FTC, and Mathlib after evaluation bridges.
roadmap.reason: Checks whether FTC reuse amortizes; do not count each degree as an independent success.

roadmap.title: Arctangent kernel on arbitrary rational subintervals
roadmap.contract: The same rectangle program for 1/(1+x*x), with a denominator-apart certificate and rational endpoints.
roadmap.reason: Reuses the arctangent bridge already established; keep that cost visible in cold and warm comparisons.

roadmap.title: The actual sine secant derivative
roadmap.contract: Validity and equivalence of the SAME fixed-schedule derivative program on the chart interior.
roadmap.reason: Compare curvature and finite differences with Mathlib differentiation plus a secant-computation bridge.

roadmap.title: Square-root inverse and its derivative away from zero
roadmap.contract: A chosen rational-bisection square-root program; explicit positive lower bound on the domain.
roadmap.reason: Tests algebraic branch selection, separation, and quantitative hypotheses.

roadmap.title: Global rational-angle addition identities
roadmap.contract: Fix the native rational-angle extension before comparing both coordinate identities.
roadmap.reason: Tests reusable function bridges without additional integration machinery.

roadmap.title: Exponential primitive
roadmap.contract: Same certified factorial-series exponential and fixed quadrature on rational bounded intervals.
roadmap.reason: Tests a new special function and amortization beyond one trigonometric family.

roadmap.title: Computable complex exponential and rotation identity
roadmap.contract: Start with the existing rational-imaginary-input complex-box evaluator; explicitly separate extension to represented complex inputs.
roadmap.reason: Tests complex arithmetic and the bridge to Mathlib's exponential without silently substituting it.

roadmap.title: Linear ODE solution and uniqueness
roadmap.contract: One prescribed matrix/forcing representation, finite product or Peano–Baker evaluator, and explicit quantitative bounds.
roadmap.reason: Tests engineering use: amortize fundamental-solution machinery across forcing terms, not across changed dynamics without justification.
